name: Phototransistor optocoupler
summary: An optical isolation component using an input light emitter and a transistor output on the isolated side.
description: An optical isolation component using an input light emitter and a transistor output on the isolated side.

On a schematic, identify the emitter current circuit, output collector/emitter and isolation boundary and trace the isolated input status or feedback path. Keep the component tag and signal/reference names consistent across the control drawing, terminal schedule and device documentation.
Optical isolation separates electrical domains; the current-transfer behaviour and output polarity are component-specific.
